name: muggle
description: Acceptance test agent for coding agents: real-browser tests, with screenshots on the PR.

interface.shortDescription: Real-browser E2E acceptance tests and PR walkthroughs
interface.longDescription: Muggle Works is the harness around your coding agent: it freezes requirements, builds the change, runs the unit suite, drives a real browser through the user flows the diff can break, and opens the pull request with step-by-step screenshots attached. Managed test identities carry live inboxes, so magic links, emailed OTPs and password resets are testable end to end.
defaultPrompt: Use $muggle:muggle-test to test the user flows my changes affect
Use $muggle:muggle-do to build this and open a PR with browser proof
Use $muggle:muggle-status to check my Muggle AI installation
